title: Brain Injury Rehabilitation Medicine Fellowship (Minnesota)
Department: Department of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
Duration: 1 year (includes two months of dedicated research time)
Deadline: 30 August of the year preceding the start date; interviews September-October
Eligibility: In training or completed a fully accredited PM&R residency in the United States or Canada
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Accreditation: Graduates eligible for ABPMR Brain Injury Medicine subspecialty exam
Application method: ERAS fellowship application plus NRMP Rehabilitation Medicine Match (Brain Injury Medicine); letter from residency PD required
Visa support: Not stated on programme page; Mayo GME general admissions page refers applicants to ECFMG for visa sponsorship information
Summary: One-year programme teaching evidence-based care of persons with acquired brain injury across acute inpatient rehabilitation, hospital consultation and outpatient practice.

title: Pediatric Rehabilitation Medicine Fellowship (Minnesota)
Department: Department of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
Deadline: 31 August of the year preceding the start date; interviews September-October
Eligibility: Completed a fully accredited PM&R residency in the United States or Canada
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Accreditation: Graduates eligible for ABPMR Pediatric Rehabilitation Medicine subspecialty exam
Application method: ERAS fellowship application plus NRMP Pediatric Rehabilitation Medicine Match; virtual interviews only
Visa support: Not stated on programme page; Mayo GME general admissions page refers applicants to ECFMG for visa sponsorship information
Summary: Two-year fellowship with required and elective rotations and dedicated research time for PM&R graduates specialising in the rehabilitation of children and adolescents.

title: PMR Sports Medicine Fellowship (Rochester, Minnesota)
Deadline: 15 August of the year preceding the start date; interviews September-November
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited PM&R residency; USMLE or COMLEX all three steps passed
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Application method: ERAS fellowship application plus NRMP Primary Care Sports Medicine Match
Visa support: Not stated on programme page; Mayo GME general admissions page refers applicants to ECFMG for visa sponsorship information
Licence requirement: USMLE/COMLEX Steps 1-3 completed per Minnesota guidelines
Summary: ACGME-accredited nonoperative sports medicine fellowship for PM&R graduates with rotations in sports, musculoskeletal and regenerative medicine clinics and team coverage.

title: PMR Sports Medicine Fellowship (Minneapolis, Minnesota)
Department: Mayo Clinic Sports Medicine (Division of Department of Orthopedic Surgery)
Deadline: 15 August of the year preceding the start date; interviews September-November
Eligibility: Completed an ACGME-accredited PM&R residency; all three USMLE/COMLEX steps passed
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Application method: ERAS fellowship application plus NRMP Sports Medicine Match
Visa support: Not stated on programme page; Mayo GME general admissions page refers applicants to ECFMG for visa sponsorship information
Licence requirement: USMLE Steps 1-3 or COMLEX Levels 1-3 completed per Minnesota guidelines
Summary: One-year accredited primary care sports medicine fellowship at Mayo Clinic Square with coverage of professional teams (Timberwolves, Lynx, Twins) and extensive musculoskeletal ultrasound training.

title: Primary Care Sports Medicine Fellowship (Florida)
Deadline: 10 August of the year preceding the start date
Eligibility: Board-eligible graduate of an accredited family medicine or PM&R residency
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Accreditation: CAQ sports medicine pathway (100% CAQ pass rate stated)
Application method: ERAS fellowship application plus NRMP Primary Care Sports Medicine Match; three letters of recommendation including PD letter
Positions: 2 per year from 2027 (one family medicine-trained, one PM&R-trained)
Visa support: Not stated on programme page; Mayo GME general admissions page refers applicants to ECFMG for visa sponsorship information
Licence requirement: Must be able to obtain a full Florida medical licence
Summary: One-year sports medicine fellowship based in the Department of Family Medicine covering athletes and active individuals, with high-school, college and event coverage and 1:1 MSK ultrasound teaching.

title: Hospital Medicine Fellowship (Eau Claire, Wisconsin)
Department: Mayo Clinic Health System — Eau Claire
Eligibility: Completed family medicine residency training by the fellowship start date
International applicants: No — applicants must be US citizens or permanent residents
Application method: Recruit (Mayo online application) or direct email to programme director with CV, personal statement and three letters; rolling review from August
Visa support: No — programme states it is unable to sponsor visas
Licence requirement: Licensed or eligible for licensure in Wisconsin
Summary: One-year hospital medicine fellowship for family medicine graduates covering complex adult inpatient care, consultation, POCUS and Mayo's Advanced Care at Home model.

title: Women's Health Fellowship (Arizona)
Deadline: 1 September for the following July start
Eligibility: Graduates of internal medicine, family medicine or obstetrics and gynaecology residencies (programme aims to train academic general internists or family practitioners)
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Visa support: Not stated on programme page; Mayo GME general admissions page refers applicants to ECFMG for visa sponsorship information
Summary: One-year fellowship training academic general internists and family physicians in menopause, sexual health, contraception, breast health and PCOS, with research and education opportunities.

title: Women's Health Fellowship (Florida)
Eligibility: Graduates of ACGME-accredited internal medicine, family medicine or obstetrics and gynaecology residencies
International applicants: Mayo GME general admissions: graduates of medical schools outside the US/Canada must hold ECFMG certification prior to appointment (or a full unrestricted licence in the programme's state)
Application method: Recruit (Mayo online application) — electronic applications only
Visa support: No — page states visa sponsorship is not offered at this time
Summary: Flexible one-year women's health fellowship (started July 2025) covering menopause, sexual health, contraception, breast health, PCOS and women's heart health.
